about: The specimen sheet layout every generator places elements by (sheet_layout.py, sheet-layout.mjs). Units are sheet pixels, y down, origin top left; a format that stores y up or other units converts when it writes. The four anchor-* nodes sit in the corners so every program's fit-to-canvas frames the sheet alike; specimens fill a grid of cells inside 'area', row by row; each specimen's caption node cap-<specimen id> sits 'captionDy' below the specimen; an edge specimen runs from 'edgeHalfSpan' left of its cell center to 'edgeHalfSpan' right of it.
